'''Shin-Ay''' was a male [[T'surr (species)|T'surr]] member of [[Ken-Kiba's spice runner gang]] who resided on the planet of [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. When [[Dass Jennir]] informed [[Ken-Kiba]] of an attack on the gang's refinery located on [[Telerath's second moon]], Shin-Ay was ordered to establish communication with [[Ken-Kiba]]'s brother [[Ken-Giree]]. However, he received no response.
